responsibility: This file implements GCC’s identifier and string interning pool. It creates and manages the cpplib-backed identifier hash table, allocates uniqued IDENTIFIER_NODEs and atomically allocated strings, provides lookup/create helpers by string and length, reports pool statistics, and contains the special GC and PCH save/restore logic needed because identifiers are rooted and purged outside normal gengtype traversal. Its responsibility is canonical storage and lifetime management for identifier text and interned string data across the compiler.
same_name_distinction: This implementation file owns the actual identifier/string interning state and machinery: the global ident_hash table, node/string allocation, lookup/create routines, statistics, and the special GC/PCH save/restore support. In contrast, gcc/stringpool.h is just the lightweight public declaration layer, including the constant-string get_identifier macro wrapper.
